rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a distinct event or incident, especially in neutral or reported contexts.

example.english: This incident caused the whole department to stop work.
example.traditional: 呢宗事件搞到成個部門停工。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 si6 gin6 gaau2 dou3 seng4 go3 bou6 mun4 ting4 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the incident is specifically an accident or unexpected mishap.

example.english: An incident happened at the company yesterday.
example.traditional: 公司噚日發生咗一宗意外。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 cam4 jat6 faat3 saang1 zo2 jat1 zung1 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this for an adverse operational incident such as a workplace or software-related disruption, rather than a neutral occurrence.

example.english: This system incident kept the whole website inaccessible all morning.
example.traditional: 今次系統事故令成個網站成朝都入唔到。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 hai6 tung2 si6 gu3 ling6 seng4 go3 mong5 zaam6 seng4 ziu1 dou1 jap6 m4 dou2
